title: D7505

page_data.en:
CONSULATE GENERAL FOR GREECE
SHANGHAI

No. 819.

Shanghai. August 26, 1936.

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Sir,

Re: George Mavridis,
ex Shanghai resident.

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your two letters dated August 20th and 24th rela-
tive to the record of the gentleman in question for
which I wish to express to you my thanks and appreci-
ation.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant.

〔此处有手写签名及圆形印章，字迹重叠难以辨认〕
P. Yannoulatos
Acting Consul General.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)）

希腊驻上海总领事馆
上海

第 819 号。

上海，1936年8月26日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处总监，
上海。

先生：

事由：乔治·马夫里迪斯（George Mavridis），
前上海居民。

谨此确认收到阁下于8月20日及24日发出的两封来函，内容涉及上述人士的档案记录，对此我谨向阁下表示谢意与感激。

此致
敬礼

〔此处有手写签名及圆形印章，字迹重叠难以辨认〕
P. Yannoulatos
代理总领事

D. 7505
S. D. 7505
Date 26 8 36

August 24 36.

The Acting Consul-General for Greece,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. 799, dated August 20, 1936, and to inform you
that there is nothing in Police records concerning
George Mavridis who formerly resided at 31/35 Seward
Road, Shanghai.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard.

Commissioner of Police.

1936年8月24日。

希腊驻上海代理总领事，

谨此回复阁下于1936年8月20日发出的第799号来函，并告知阁下，关于曾居住于上海西华德路31/35号的乔治·马夫里迪斯（George Mavridis），警方档案中并无任何记录。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S. B. D. Station 8
REPORT
File No. SPECIAL
REGIST. 7505
Date August 24, 1936.

Subject (in full) Communication dated August 20, 1936 from the Consul General
of Greece regarding one George MAVRIDIS.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

Beyond the fact that several years ago Mavridis resided
at 31/35 Seward Road, whence on May 10, 1930 he removed to
the French Concession, later transferring to Tientsin, nothing
is known of this individual from a Police point of view.
He has no police record and there is nothing on file in
Shanghai Municipal Police records concerning him in any way.

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime & Special Branches).

（左侧批注：dSR / 24/8.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科 S. B. D. 第8站
报告
档案编号：特别
登记号 7505
日期：1936年8月24日

主题（全称）：希腊总领事于1936年8月20日就一名叫乔治·马夫里迪斯（George MAVRIDIS）的人士发出的公函。

由 D.S. Pitts 撰写。由警司 J. Boyne 转呈。

除获悉马夫里迪斯数年前曾居住于西华德路31/35号，并于1930年5月10日搬往法租界，随后又转往天津外，从警方角度而言，对该人一无所知。他无警方犯罪记录，上海公共租界工部局警务处档案中亦无任何与其相关的文件。

D.S. Pitts
副总监
（刑事及特务科）

（左侧批注：dSR / 24/8.）

CONSULATE GENERAL FOR GREECE
SHANGHAI

No. 799.

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写内容，可见 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL... S. B. D... Date...〕

Shanghai, August 20, 1936.

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Sir,

Re: George Mavridis,
ex Shanghai resident.

I have the honour to request you to let
me have at your convenience any information you may ha-
ve on file regarding the record of the gentleman in que-
stion. This information is asked for by the Greek Con-
sulate General at Tientsin, where this gentleman is now
residing.

Your communication on the subject will be
greatly appreciated.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕

Per. Yannoulacos,
Acting Consul General.
page_data.zh:
希腊驻上海总领事馆
上海

第 799 号。

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写内容，可见 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL... S. B. D... Date...〕

上海，1936年8月20日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处总监，
上海。

先生：

事由：乔治·马夫里迪斯（George Mavridis），
前上海居民。

谨请阁下在方便之时，提供贵处档案中可能持有的关于上述人士记录的任何信息。此信息系应天津希腊总领事馆之要求而索取，该人士目前居住于天津。

如蒙赐复，不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

〔此处为手写签名〕

Yannoulacos 代签，
代理总领事
